messages:
nina: FYI console team pushed a tweak to routing-policy headers this morning (Header-Route -> X-Redwood-Route). seeing sporadic failures reported by a couple of python clients. anyone seen stacktraces?

liam: I grabbed one: AttributeError in py-sdk while reading headers: 'Response' object has no attribute 'headers' (weird). logs show lower-level middleware expecting lowercase header keys.

jen: oh no, we recently normalized header casing in the console to Title-Case for consistency with other services. py-requests gives a case-insensitive dict, but our wrapper in py-sdk does dict['headers'] with exact key.

matt: that wrapper was added in py-sdk v1.3.0 to simplify tests. it's brittle. we should revert to case-insensitive lookup and add a test for header casing.

nina: product: priority is customer continuity. propose 1) hotfix py-sdk to be case-insensitive, 2) revert console casing change for prod until SDKs pick up patch, 3) add dashboard panel for header-change deploys.

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-py/issues/298 "py-sdk: tolerate header casing and metadata format variations"

liam: I'll open PR for py-sdk that replaces exact-key access with response.headers.get('x-redwood-route') and adds unit + integration test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-py/pull/899

jen: console: rolling back casing change in prod flag now. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for feature-flag "route-header-casing". ETA ~5m.

matt: small addendum: there's also a quota dashboard mismatch — console started showing token_count vs token_estimate; some teams saw quota alerts hit earlier than expected. ops: can we surface a clear mapping and a migration note?

nina: ops please add a migration tile in the console explaining token_count vs token_estimate and add a short TTL to prevent noisy alerts for 2h during rollout.

ci-bot: Dashboard ticket OPS-220 created and pinged: https://tickets.redwood/OPS-220

liam: py-sdk patch merged and released v1.3.1 to PyPI. changelog includes tolerance for header casing and guidance to upgrade.

jen: will re-enable casing change in 24h after SDK uptake looks good. thanks for the quick turn. :thumbsup:

nina: follow-ups: 1) devex to draft advisory for customers 2) eng-platform to add header-change audit log to Deploy Console 3) ops to monitor quota-alerts for 48h.

matt: noted and on it. closing thread after monitoring window.
